'''Vink''' was a [[dwarf opee sea killer]] that was kept in the [[Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility|Zoological Research Facility]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] along with [[Nink (dwarf opee sea killer)|Nink]], another member of its [[Species/Legends|species]]. Both creatures escaped the zoo when a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] named [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] accidentally released them.
